title: Evidence-Gated Research: Statistically Controlled Model Adoption in Adaptive Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.01751v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adaptive model search is path dependent: once a challenger is adopted, it becomes the reference from which later candidates are generated. A statistically unsupported replacement can therefore alter hypotheses that have not yet been proposed. We introduce Evidence-Gated Research (EGR), a statistical adoption layer for moving-incumbent search. EGR freezes each challenger before decision evidence is revealed, builds anytime-valid evidence across a predeclared set of environments, routes evidence predictably toward unresolved components, composes a persistent candidate e-value, and passes that e-value to an online controller. Under explicit conditional-validity and predictability conditions, the resulting procedure controls false discovery rate for the declared all-environment adoption target even though earlier adoptions change later challengers. In a 5,000-trajectory closed-loop benchmark, development-only e-LOND attains persistent FDR 0.

translated_title: 证据门控研究：自适应搜索中具有统计控制的模型采纳
translated_abstract: 自适应模型搜索具有路径依赖性：一旦某个挑战者被采纳，它就会成为后续候选者生成的参考基准。因此，缺乏统计支持的替换可能会改变尚未被提出的假设。我们提出了证据门控研究，这是一种面向动态现任者搜索的统计采纳层。EGR 在决策证据揭晓之前冻结每个挑战者，在一组预先声明的环境上构建随时有效的证据，以可预测的方式将证据引导至未解决的组件，组合出持久的候选 e 值，并将该 e 值传递给在线控制器。在明确的条件有效性与可预测性条件下，即使先前的采纳会改变后续的挑战者，该程序仍能针对声明的全环境采纳目标控制错误发现率（FDR）。在包含 5,000 条轨迹的闭环基准测试中，仅在开发阶段运行的 e-LOND 实现了持续的 FDR 为 0。
tldr: 该论文提出证据门控研究（EGR），通过在决策证据揭晓前冻结挑战者、构建随时有效的 e 值证据并交由在线控制器，实现了路径依赖的自适应模型搜索中对错误发现率的统计控制。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Evidence-Gated Research (EGR), a statistical adoption layer that freezes challengers before evidence is revealed and composes anytime-valid e-values to provably control false discovery rate in path-dependent adaptive model search.
